title: Performance of flame retardancy silk modified with water-soluble vinyl phosphoamide
treatment_method: Degummed and bleached source silk, no graft treatment
LOI_method: ASTM D 2863; Fire Testing Technology oxygen index instrument
TG_locator: Table I, p 2338, explicitly thermal analysis from Figure 4: DTG peaks and TG residue at 600 C.
LOI_locator: Table II, p 2339: DMMEPN P-N columns, control and 100% monomer-on-fabric states.
conditions_locator: Characterization pp 2336-2337: nitrogen 100 mL/min, 10 C/min, 40-600 C; LOI method.
pairing_evidence: Figure 4 and thermal-results prose explicitly identify FR silk as the 24.22% weight-gain DMMEPN specimen. source_location: Original final article pp 2336-2340, Table I, Table II, Figure 4 caption and preparation.
limitations: Original final-PDF indexed text for preparation, methods, thermal/LOI tables, figure caption and conclusions reviewed. PDF byte requests failed and pixel QA is unavailable. Table II residues are separate 600 C/10 min incineration results, not TG. Table I Td is at 11% loss, not T5/T10 or generic onset, so omitted from clean TG fields. FR first DTG peak is modifier decomposition and second peak is silk decomposition. A physical-property paragraph says 21.22% weight gain versus 24.22% in Table II/IV and Figure 4; normalized add-on is withheld and no alias is inferred. DMMEP columns are earlier-paper comparison, not new paired states.
